title: Deployment-run QA
summary: Acceptance and execution use complete frozen plan/case selections. Authorized withdrawals, rematerialization and replacements retain source ancestry and target checks. An incomplete historical selection names operator repair recovery; raw historical requirements and results remain viewable without current-definition reinterpretation. Unfinished private member QA runs before shared groups on its own scoped cursor; completing it does not start a shared campaign. Member acceptance still requires all private and attached shared evidence.
